chalisa.do1: Śāradā, a self-manifest image, has come to Maihar and is enthroned there, holding a rosary and a book, with the vīṇā adorning her hand.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory, victory to Śāradā, the great queen; you are the primal Śakti, who brings welfare to the world. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Mother, your form has four arms; you are famed in the three worlds. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: About two thousand years ago, as it is reckoned, Śāradā appeared; the world knows it. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: The town of Maihar is famed throughout the world, where Śāradā, mother of the world, is seated. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Śāradā dwells on the mountain Trikūṭa; the town of Maihar shines with supreme light. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Your face is like the autumn moon; your four-armed form is exceedingly lovely. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: The pure radiance of your body is like ten million suns; the royal swan is your pure vehicle. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Swinging earrings look lovely in your ears; the jewel on your breast and your forehead appear beyond compare. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: You hold the vīṇā, the book and the gesture of fearlessness; you are the mother of the world, and you move through the world. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: You are the daughter of Brahmā, undivided and incomparable; the king of the gods sings Śāradā's virtues. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Viṣṇu and Śiva bow to Śāradā; Varuṇa and Kubera pay her honour. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Śāradā's form came down as the Caṇḍī incarnation, who slew the demons Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: The auspicious Śāradā, becoming Durgā, as Bhavānī slew Mahiṣāsura. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Taking that form, Śāradā became Caṇḍī, and wearing her garland of heads she cut down Raktabīja in battle. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Tulasīdāsa, Sūradāsa and other learned men have always told of Śāradā's fair fame. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: By your mercy, Mother Śāradā, Kālidāsa became greatly renowned. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Vālmīki, Nārada, the sages and the gods serve Śāradā again and again. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: O Māyā of the world, give me the refuge of your feet; Śāradā's māyā pervades the whole world. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Śāradā dwells in every atom and particle, full of supreme power, supreme light. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: O Śāradā, you are the very form of Brahman; Śiva, Brahmā, men and kings worship you. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Between Brahman and Śakti there is not a single difference; the Vedas sing Śāradā's virtues. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Victory to you, worshipped by the world, whose form is the universe; without attributes and with attributes, both are Śāradā's forms. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Remember Śāradā's name without a break, and the fierce age of Kali will not touch you. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: The sun, the moon and the stars of the heavens all shine by Śāradā's grace. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: I bow to Śāradā, who brings about creation, preservation and dissolution, the saviour of the world. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: By your grace, Mother Śāradā, all sorrow and poverty are destroyed. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Mother Śāradā, your knowledge is most pure, the support of the world. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Giver of happiness, from you come learning and wisdom. Victory, victory, victory to Śāradā Bhavānī. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Those who worship Śāradā surely cross the ocean of worldly existence. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: By Śāradā's grace pure knowledge is gained, and great good comes in every way. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: The objects of the world bring great sorrow; by worshipping Śāradā great happiness is gained. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Śāradā, your light is supreme; send its divine rays towards me. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Whoever remembers Mother Śāradā, his mind is absorbed in supreme bliss. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Through japa and meditation the mind grows calm; by worshipping Śāradā knowledge comes. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: This is a composition made about Śāradā; those who recite it are freed from the round of worldly existence. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Whoever reads it with hundreds of salutations and a mind intent on her, Mother Śāradā will bring him good. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Who in the world has known Śāradā's glory? The Vedas tell of it, saying: Not this, not this. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Hundreds of salutations to you, Śāradā; turn your gracious glance towards me. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Those who serve you meet with no heavy sorrow anywhere. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Whoever recites this Chālīsā, Mother Śāradā, give him your blessing. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: I bow to the dust of Śāradā's feet; give me devotion and knowledge. Drive away all ignorance, and dwell forever in the home of my heart.
chalisa.do3: Victory, victory to Mother Śāradā; Maihar is your abode. Mother, take me into your refuge; I worship you without desire for reward.
